title: Services
heading: Therapy shaped around you.
intro: Every person who walks through my door carries a different story. My work adapts to yours.
expectation: Therapy with me is collaborative, unhurried, and grounded in safety. Sessions are 50 minutes and held weekly or bi-weekly depending on your needs. I offer both in-person appointments in New York City and telehealth sessions for clients located in New York, New Jersey, and California.
consultation: Before we begin, I offer a free 15-minute phone consultation — a chance to ask questions, share what's brought you here, and get a sense of whether working together feels right. There's no pressure and no commitment.

items.title: Trauma & PTSD
items.tagline: Finding safety in your own body again.
items.body: Trauma can leave you feeling disconnected from yourself, hypervigilant, or trapped in the past. Using EMDR, IFS, and attachment-based approaches, we work gently to process what happened — at a pace that feels safe — so it no longer holds the same power over your present.

items.title: Anxiety & Depression
items.tagline: Support for worry, low mood, and self-doubt.
items.body: Anxiety and depression can affect your energy, confidence, relationships, and sense of purpose. We explore the patterns behind worry, self-criticism, or low mood, and use tools such as CBT, mindfulness, and IFS to support change that fits your life.

items.title: Grief & Loss
items.tagline: Making space for what you've had to let go.
items.body: Grief doesn't follow a timeline, and it doesn't only come from death. Loss of a relationship, a version of yourself, a future you imagined — all of it deserves to be witnessed. I offer a space where grief can be held without being rushed or fixed.

items.title: Life Transitions
items.body: Major transitions — a new city, a career shift, the end of a relationship, becoming a parent — can shake our sense of identity and belonging. Therapy can be a steady anchor while the ground shifts beneath you.
